quotes.text: [Amadou] Onana is [out] for a long time, but is progressing very well. [Ian] Maatsen is progressing very well, but still out.
Brooksy [David Brooks] is fully in team training… It’s a muscle injury and we do [a scan] in some days again, but we are going to miss him [Alex Scott], for sure, for four or five weeks.
Antoni [Milambo] and Josh [Dasilva] definitely won’t be involved tomorrow. The rest of them have been on the grass…
Lewis [Dunk] will be back. Jack [Hinshelwood] trained this week.
He’s ready to go. Finally! You have been asking this question and we have used the time with Moi [Moises Caicedo] to be back fit.
Milan [van Ewijk] is back training with us, so that’s good news. We hope he’ll be alright…
Anan Khalaili is ready to play 90 minutes… Ismaïla Sarr is now able to start.
[Vitalii Mykolenko] has got a chance for Sunday, the extra day might help.
We are very happy because everybody is back and fit. At the moment, everybody is fit and available.
Joe Rodon is on his way back in his rehab… Daniel James will miss the Arsenal game.
Alex Isak and Cody Gakpo will not play the game. They are not ready.
He’s [Erling Haaland] good, he’s good… ready for Anfield.
Ben [Benjamin Sesko] is further away, with the issue he has got. He won’t be ready.
For now, we hope that three or four players are ready to be in the squad… They have the potential to be in the squad but, for sure, not in the starting XI.
It’s a shame for [Dan] Ballard because he was in a good place and he will be sidelined for a few weeks.
